# Cebu Real Estate Shop

> > Your comprehensive source for house and lot properties in Liloan, Northern Cebu, and surrounding areas including Danao City, Compostela, and Catarman.

Cebu Real Estate Shop specializes in residential property listings across Northern Cebu, featuring subdivisions like Danarra North, Ashana Coast Residences, Citadel Estate, Serenis Plains, The Preston, Valencia, and 77 Living Spaces. The site focuses on house and lot sales in key municipalities from Liloan to the northern coastal and inland communities.
